list.title: Dispatch Orders
list.description: Five-state lifecycle (draft → assigned → executing → done, plus the cancelled terminal state); select a row to operate (assembly/electrical dispatch is hard-blocked by kit completeness).
list.empty: No dispatch orders under the current filters

stats.title: State Statistics
stats.description: Counts follow the current search scope (state dimension excluded); display only, not clickable filters.

batch.title: List Batch Operations
batch.description: Batch assign & release (every selected order must be pending release; the whole batch is assigned to one assignee); batch delete only for pending-release part/outsourcing orders (assembly/electrical/odd job/aftermarket exempt).
batch.assignee-label: Batch release assignee (selected orders are assigned to)
batch.assign-done: Batch assign & release completed: {{ok}}/{{total}} order(s) succeeded
batch.assign-rejected: Batch assign & release rejected as a whole: {{reason}}
batch.delete-rejected: Batch delete rejected as a whole: {{reason}}

detail.title: Dispatch Order Detail & Operations
detail.description: Outsourcing completion triggers a linked inspection on return; assembly/electrical completion rolls progress up to the work order.
detail.qty-label: Done Qty (optional; whole order by default)
detail.transfer-assignee-label: Transfer new assignee (at least one of new assignee / new operation)

create.title: Create Dispatch Order
create.description: Six kinds: part requires drawing number + operation; outsourcing requires detail lines (supplier + operation + qty); assembly/electrical require an operation; aftermarket/odd job require a title or an operation.
create.no-permission: The current account does not have permission to create dispatch orders; the form is disabled. Please contact an administrator to grant the permission, then refresh the page to use it.
create.op-label: Operation (required for most kinds; outsourcing line = operation code)

tasks.title: Task Views
tasks.description: Query tasks by assignee (required) or by work order (two views).
tasks.wo-placeholder: Select or enter a work order
tasks.empty-wo: No tasks for this work order
